categories.main_business_segments: Foshan Haitian Flavouring and Food Company Ltd. primarily operates in the production and sale of condiments including soy sauce, oyster sauce, fermented sauces, vinegar, cooking wine, and compound seasonings. The company also engages in the production and sale of grains, oils, fermented beverages, and related food products. It maintains a diversified product portfolio catering to both household consumers and commercial clients.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company relies on traditional fermentation and brewing techniques enhanced by proprietary microbial strain selection and fermentation technology. It integrates modern automated, digital, and intelligent manufacturing processes, including fully automated sterilization, closed circular qu production, and continuous pressing lines. These technologies ensure product quality, flavor consistency, and flexible production to meet diverse market demands.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Haitian serves a broad customer base including household consumers, industrial food producers, and commercial foodservice clients. Its products are widely used in daily cooking and by food manufacturers, with tailored solutions for different culinary applications. The company also targets emerging market segments such as organic and low-sodium products to meet evolving consumer preferences.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with production bases in Guangdong, Jiangsu, Guangxi, and other provinces. It has expanded its presence through subsidiaries and investments in regions including Hainan, Zhejiang, Anhui, and overseas markets such as Vietnam and Hong Kong. Its sales network covers eastern, southern, central, northern, and western regions of China, ensuring balanced regional market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haitian operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing, processing, and distribution of condiments and related food products. It manages raw material procurement, production, and extensive sales and distribution channels, including offline and online platforms, to deliver products to end consumers and commercial clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in fermentation technology and product quality enhancement. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on high-performance microbial strains, flavor and quality control, rapid detection technologies, and development of organic, low-salt, and functional products. Digital transformation and smart manufacturing are strategic priorities to improve operational efficiency and market responsiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Haitian generates revenue primarily through product sales of its condiment and food product lines. Sales are conducted mainly via a broad network of distributors and direct sales channels, including online platforms. The company also earns income from logistics services and related food product trading activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haitian is the leading brand in China's condiment industry, holding the top market share in soy sauce, oyster sauce, and fermented sauces for multiple consecutive years. It is recognized as the industry leader with strong brand equity and technological advantages, competing against other domestic and international condiment manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Haitian reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 24.56 billion, a slight decline of 4.1% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 5.63 billion, down 9.21%. The company maintains a strong net asset base of RMB 28.53 billion with steady growth. Despite short-term pressures, it sustains robust cash flow generation and continues to invest in capacity expansion and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haitian differentiates itself through its commitment to traditional craftsmanship combined with modern technology, ensuring high-quality, authentic flavors. Its proprietary fermentation strains and processes create unique taste profiles, while diversified product lines address health-conscious and convenience-oriented consumer needs. The company emphasizes food safety, product innovation, and comprehensive customer service to maintain market leadership.
